claim: A single omniseek_search call with the frozen need as the query returns text containing the claim key.
frozen_need: I left my university two years ago and now do research on my own time, with no affiliation and no grant. I keep hitting walls: submission portals that reject non-institutional email, fee waiver policies that seem keyed to the author's country rather than their employment status, and a suspicion that putting "Independent Researcher" on the affiliation line changes how desk editors read the manuscript. Which social-science venues genuinely work for unaffiliated authors, and how do people in that position actually cover the fees?
